statement: The reporting service at http://report:8080/fetch?url=<url> renders link previews for internal users and blocks requests to internal address ranges on the URL you give it. An internal metadata service lives at http://169.254.169.254/latest/creds and hands out a per-boot token; the object store at host objectstore port 9000 serves /backup/flag.txt to requests carrying ?token=<t>. Both metadata and object store are only reachable from the report host itself. Retrieve the backup's contents.
